select base a coprime to N and step the modular orbit
chain orbit steps into one measurable walk

mark odd order and retain N unsplit for fresh base selection
rejoin parity arms into one orbit verdict
compose verified gcd with N to state candidate factor pair
coincide fiducial apparatus with the fixed orbit point
reverse the orbit to confirm return to unity at measured period
hold p times q together as one semiprime state
fix the confirmed prime pair in permanent record
anchor closure at N equal to p times q
